indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: Price of Travel's Hostel Index row lists New York City, USA, Chelsea International Hostel, at $51.75 per night. The page methodology says this is the price per night including taxes and fees for one person in a shared dorm room, using the average of a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; index published 16 Jan 2023
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world New York City United States Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact city row and source-defined one-person shared-dorm basis were found; no scaling, ratio, or FX conversion was performed.
